name: David Ipate
intro: I capture real places and objects as 3D scenes in photographic detail, so you can walk around them in your browser: artworks shown online the way they stand in the room, important places archived as they are, homes you can tour before you visit, food you can turn on your screen.

Christmas tree
scenes.text: A decorated tree and its presents in a lobby, captured on a Fuji X-T20 with a fisheye lens.
